verdict.rationale: Document AI's annotation and Document QnA features generate AI-derived insights directly from documents (key clause/vendor/amount extraction, natural-language Q&A, multi-document comparison), which is the core 'insights from data' capability for a document-AI product. Community evidence corroborates strong OCR/extraction accuracy in real use, supporting the underlying insight pipeline. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of the Q&A/annotation insight features (community evidence focuses mainly on OCR accuracy), and no evidence of proactive/automated suggestion surfacing beyond query-driven Q&A.
